values.en:
Terminology for logic. The Pointer opens the complete registration module. Native declaration names and full argument indices are preserved; named `english` styles extend, rather than replace, existing upstream defaults.

| Lean constant | Style | Display template |
|---|---|---|
| `False` | `default` | `\bot` |
| `Ne` | `default` | `#1 \ne #2` |
| `ExistsUnique` | `default` | `\exists! #1` |
| `Decidable` | `default` | `#0 is decidable` |
| `DecidableEq` | `default` | `Equality on #0 is decidable` |
| `Subsingleton` | `default` | `#0 has at most one element` |
| `Nontrivial` | `default` | `#0 has at least two distinct elements` |
| `Unique` | `default` | `#0 has a unique element` |
| `IsEmpty` | `default` | `#0 is empty` |
| `Nonempty` | `english` | `#0 has an element` |
